key.name: lock-grace-seconds
key.summary: Lock this long after the display turns off (0 = immediately)

key.name: power-key-locks-instantly
key.summary: The power key locks at once, whatever the grace period

key.name: lockscreen-camera
key.summary: Camera shortcut on the lock screen (restricted camera, photos of this session only)

key.name: emergency-on-lockscreen
key.summary: Show the emergency information on the lock screen

key.name: emergency-info
key.summary: Emergency information (JSON: ownerName, ownerMessage, bloodType, allergies, medications, conditions, notes, organDonor, contacts[{name, relation, number}])

key.name: sos-enabled
key.summary: Press the power key quickly several times to call the emergency number

key.name: sos-presses
key.summary: Number of quick power presses that start SOS

key.name: sos-countdown
key.summary: Seconds to cancel before the call starts

key.name: sos-send-sms
key.summary: After the call, text the emergency contacts with the location

key.name: test-mode
key.summary: Test mode: SOS and the lock-screen contact buttons only show what they would do (no call, no SMS)

key.name: indicators-enabled
key.summary: Show a status-bar icon while an app uses the camera, microphone or location

key.name: wifi-mac-modes
key.summary: Per saved network: "uuid TAB mode", mode = default, stable, random or device

key.name: wifi-networks
key.summary: Saved Wi-Fi networks as "uuid TAB name TAB mode" (written by fp6-privacyd)

key.name: clipboard-clear-minutes
key.summary: Clear the clipboard this many minutes after the last copy (0 = never)

key.name: clipboard-read-notify
key.summary: Notify when an app reads (pastes) the clipboard
